text:
Ethan (Product): FYI: launching Private Backup Export API v1 to on-prem/VPC customers tonight at 22:00 UTC. Purpose: let customers pull a single encrypted export of tenant artifacts (model prompts, ephemeral logs, configs) with a verifiable export manifest. This also introduces export-token rotation and an audit manifest format.

Rhea (Eng): Impl notes: exports are generated locally, envelope-encrypted with customer-provided public key (or our ephemeral key if not provided). Manifest fields: export_id, files[], manifest_sha256, signer_kid, kms_key_hint, ts. Example trigger: ```curl -X POST https://127.0.0.1:8443/agent/export -H 'Authorization: Bearer <agent_token>' -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","export_type":"full","pubkey":"-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----..."}'``` Returns: export_id + status_url.

Sam (SRE): Rollout plan: canary 6 sites 22:00-22:15, watch export-failure-rate and manifest-mismatch-rate. Alert if manifest-mismatch > 0.1% over 10m or export jobs queue depth > 5.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start for private-export-api-v1 at 2026-06-12T22:00Z.

Ethan (Product): Action items: Eng - document export manifest and rotation steps; Legal - review wording for export attestation; Support - KB + canned responses; Sales - 2-line customer notice.

Olga (Legal): Quick note: attestation sentence should state what we sign (manifest + signer_kid) and what we do not (we don’t attest to contents beyond platform metadata). Need the signer key id included in manifest for audit evidence.

Trent (Sales): Can we get a 25-word blurb for customers and a short FAQ? Also need the canary customer list for CSM heads-up.

Rhea (Eng): Draft blurb: "Export tenant artifacts as an encrypted bundle from your Private/VPC agent. Each export includes a signed manifest (id, checksum, signer) for verification." Full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Sam (SRE): Canary update @22:08: 6 exports queued, 6 completed, median export time 420ms, 0 manifest-mismatch. Promoting to staged rollout at 22:20.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated for private-export-api-v1 at 2026-06-12T22:20Z.

Pri (Support): Adding KB: "How to request and verify an on-prem export" with steps: call status_url, download envelope, verify manifest_sha256, verify signer_kid, decrypt with customer key. Will include troubleshooting for key mismatch & token rotation.

Ethan (Product): Rotation policy: export-tokens rotate every 24h by default. Eng will expose a manual rotation endpoint for customers who want immediate rekey. Include note in KB.

Rhea (Eng): Manual rotation endpoint: ```POST /agent/export/rotate-token -H 'Authorization: Bearer <agent_admin>' -d '{"tenant_id":"acme"}'``` Returns new_token + expiry. Logs emit rotation events to local audit store.

Sam (SRE): Follow-ups: add Grafana panels for export queue depth and manifest verification failures; create alert runbook "export-manifest-fail" with steps to collect agent logs and retry export. Runbook path: https://redir.company/runbooks/private-export-api.

Olga (Legal): Legal ok to GA once Support KB links and a short audit sentence are present. Proposed audit sentence: "The platform produces a signed export manifest (export_id, manifest_sha256, signer_kid, timestamp) to evidence that an export was produced; the customer is responsible for decrypting and validating contents."

Trent (Sales): :thumbsup: prepping customer outreach for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Will request CSM list from ops.

Ethan (Product): Thanks all. If anything strange appears in the next 48h tag #eng-oncall and @Ethan. I'll post the final GA draft here after Support + Legal confirm KB link.
